blocks.text: 0 % is idle throttle at 1300 µs PWM, 100 % is 1920 µs. Runs start with the ESC case within 3 °C of ambient, and are discarded if the supply drops below 50.0 V.
Itemised per test in Table 1, with the outcome in Table 3. Characterisation and step response are measurements and carry no criterion.
Input power against PWM fits a single cubic within 2 % between 1400 and 1900 µs. Peak was 4031 W at 77.5 A and 5180 RPM, at 1920 µs and 52.0 V.
P in watts, t in microseconds, valid 1300 to 1920 µs.

blocks.text: Acceleration 1150 → 1950 µs settles within 2 % in 410 ms. Deceleration takes 1.28 s, set by propeller inertia – phase current reaches zero within 40 ms of the command.
500 cycles of 900 µs and 1300 µs, input and phase current logged. No interruption, every start-up showed the same current signature.

The first high-load run failed 25 s into the 1850 µs hold: input current collapsed from 71 A to zero in one sample, case temperature 106 °C at the last good sample. Dissection showed at least one failed FET.
Root cause: thermal. The ESC was a bare board in heatshrink with no heatsink and no airflow, run outside its cooling configuration.

Action: repeated with the production heatsink and 2 m/s airflow – completed 30 min, case stable at 78 °C. Bare-board operation at sustained high load is excluded, and the burn-in procedure requires the heatsink fitted.
The E7000 motor and ESC perform satisfactorily for use in AltaX in the production cooling configuration. Not qualified for bare-board operation at sustained high load.

items: Release the burn-in procedure: 1850 µs for 30 min, heatsink fitted, reject above 90 °C case.
Use the cubic in section 6.1 for the flight-time model – the supplier curve overstates power below 1500 µs by up to 9 %.
Temperature extremes open under EV1-62, owned by the environmental lab. Qualification is conditional on that suite passing.
Repeat arm/disarm cycling on adapter revision D.
